exact: voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in SAN cell action potential depolarization
voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in sinoatrial node cell action potential depolarization
narrow: voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in sinus node cell action potential depolarization

definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of an SA node cardiac muscle cell contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.
label: voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in SA node cell action potential depolarization
